item.description: তিন দশকেরও বেশি সময়ে একটি নির্জন এলাকার চারপাশে কৃষিজমির জায়গায় বাজার ও সরকারি-বেসরকারি নানা প্রতিষ্ঠান গড়ে উঠেছে। বর্তমানে সেখানে কেবল পুরোনো নামের স্মৃতিটুকুই টিকে আছে।

item.title: Paraguay's Ueno Bank Manages Millions of Public Funds
item.description: By June, ueno bank reported serving approximately three million clients within a nation of 6.5 million residents. The financial institution also manages nearly $850 million in government funds.

item.title: Iranian Security Official Delivers Message to Vladimir Putin
item.description: Russia's leader met with Iran's chief security official to confer on regional security matters. During the meeting, a communication from Mojtaba Khamenei was delivered.

item.title: High Demand for Sessions at Upcoming Vizag Junior Literary Fest
item.description: Sign-ups are currently underway for the Vizag Junior Literary Fest ahead of its November 21 opening. Organizers report that attendance slots for restricted-capacity events are filling rapidly.

item.title: Maharashtra Allocates ₹160 Crore in Budget for Primitive Tribes
item.description: The Maharashtra administration earmarked ₹160 crore for vulnerable tribal groups in the 2026-27 budget. This includes ₹130 crore for primitive tribes and ₹30 crore for the Pardhi community, alongside full state funding for benefit schemes.

item.title: Addressing Fatal Incidents During Sewer Maintenance in India
item.description: Authorities in India face calls to eradicate hazardous working conditions responsible for ongoing fatalities among sanitation workers.

item.title: Faridabad CMO Threatened by Fake Vigilance Officer
item.description: Police apprehended a man in Faridabad who posed as a vigilance representative named by the Rashtrapati Bhavan. The individual had contacted local authorities claiming he was sent to probe a local ambulance fuel fraud.

item.title: Photographer Documents Calcutta Yellow Taxis in New Book
item.description: Photographer Ananth Padmanabhan highlights Calcutta's iconic yellow cabs in his publication titled No Refusal. The project reflects on the historical significance and eventual decline of these vehicles over three decades.

item.title: Actor Josh O'Connor Linked to James Bond Role
item.description: Media reports suggest that Emmy winner Josh O'Connor, known for his work on The Crown, has been selected to play James Bond. This casting rumor surfaced after statements made by a fellow cast member.

item.title: Apple Reduces AI Spending Budgets for Engineering Staff
item.description: Technology firm Apple has reportedly decreased artificial intelligence expenditure limits for its developers. Daily allowances for certain engineering staff utilizing AI models dropped from $300 to $200 as part of budget reductions.

item.title: Visakhapatnam Businesses Offer Eco-Friendly Festive Gifts
item.description: Local businesses in Visakhapatnam are promoting sustainable holiday gifting through organic foods, handmade crafts, wellness baskets, and traditional clay lamps. This trend reflects an increasing consumer focus on environmental responsibility.

item.description: Left-wing politician Abdul El-Sayed defines himself as a capitalist who comprehends market mechanics while maintaining progressive views. Prominent figures like Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez previously supported his electoral bid.

item.title: Global Crude Oil Rates Recover Near $100 per Barrel
item.description: Crude oil values rebounded toward the $100 benchmark following recent multi-month lows driven by geopolitical friction. Ongoing Middle East conflicts have impacted refinery productivity and spurred market gains.

item.title: Consumers Express Disappointment Over Green Crackers
item.description: Traders report that late licensing reduced the sales period for seasonal fireworks, while consumers remain dissatisfied due to the lack of traditional noise levels from eco-friendly alternatives.

item.title: Timeline of Nicolas Cage and Riko Shibata's Relationship
item.description: Nicolas Cage and Riko Shibata met in Japan in early 2020 and married in Las Vegas on February 16, 2021, amid the pandemic. They later welcomed a child together.

item.title: Centre informs Supreme Court it may review UGC equity rules
item.description: The Union government announced to the Supreme Court that it is contemplating the formation of a committee to re-examine the current framework of equity guidelines.

item.title: Elon Musk removes pro-GOP posts following election outcomes
item.description: After investing $458 million in support of Republican candidates, Elon Musk deleted his social media messages promoting the party following Democratic wins.

item.title: Blaze breaks out in Delhi's Karol Bagh ahead of Diwali
item.description: A fire started in Karol Bagh, Delhi, prompting authorities to dispatch 22 fire engines, along with additional water bowsers and lighting units.

item.title: Top Court clears Maharashtra school staff over 2020 death
item.description: The Supreme Court cleared Maharashtra school administrators of criminal liability in a 2020 pillar collapse death, stating they were not at fault for construction flaws.

item.title: White House refutes claims of Hegseth and Rubio departures
item.description: The White House dismissed media speculation regarding the exits of Pete Hegseth and Mark Rubio following recent electoral defeats for the Republican party.
